response.sql: WITH race_totals AS (SELECT r.name, SUM(res.points) AS total_points FROM races AS r JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId GROUP BY r.name), average_total AS (SELECT AVG(total_points) AS value FROM race_totals), above_average AS (SELECT rt.name, rt.total_points, rt.total_points - a.value AS excess_points FROM race_totals AS rt CROSS JOIN average_total AS a WHERE rt.total_points > a.value) SELECT (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM above_average) AS combined_total_points, AVG(CAST(res.laps AS REAL)) AS average_laps_completed, (SELECT AVG(excess_points) FROM above_average) AS average_excess_points FROM above_average AS aa JOIN races AS r ON r.name = aa.name JOIN results AS res ON res.raceId = r.raceId;
